item.title: Sequential Thinking
item.description: The Sequential Thinking server provides a single tool that lets an agent externalize a chain of reasoning as discrete, revisable steps rather than reasoning silently in one pass. The host model decides when to call it, and can branch, revise, or extend earlier steps as its understanding develops.
